title: Bound the fixed chart-1051 ingress for helper 1310
body:
## Result

**NO VERIFIED GAIN.** On exact #7481, the fixed chart-1051 boundary before ADD38219 cannot split helper 1310's rank-nine productive target into ranks five and four. The exact reverse calculation grants all 11 unchanged coframed rows, including role1311's already-paid MOVE38218. Input x890=1 makes both historical donors respond (1,0), while every granted donor row vanishes. The first outward ADD38220 observes the missing contribution.

Independent literal forward replay also uses x890=1, x1310=−1 and a zero fresh helper. The entire old chart-1051 bank and the new helper then match the all-zero case, while the required returned x1310 differs. This excludes any recovery restricted to that local state under the fixed incoming routes and output requirement. The one cut exhausted with zero unresolved in scope. Earlier encodings, changed arrivals and different cuts remain open.

Across the 17 signed calls, the hypothetical productive delta is +17 each at ranks four and five and −17 at rank nine. The paid histogram is fixed. Directed gross is approximately 0.38075659829390935 raw before realization costs. One extra rank-one paid position per call costs 17 raw. No construction or saving was realized.

## Exact inputs and replay

Canonical main e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57, comparator #7481 at 89eaa9d8cae37c1540de98f2d29a3abaabb96a2b and signed #7113 at 07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d. This is a distinct fixed native productive split site from #7497 and #7142. The two #7257 CI prerequisites are separate ancestors.

From a clean POSIX checkout with CPython 3.12 and its standard library, run

    python3.12 -I -B research/p104-helper1310-fixed-ingress-bound/replay.py

Expected PASS_HELPER1310_FIXED_INGRESS_BOUND. Both scientific runners exited zero within 30 seconds. Direct and registered replay, exact committed source and modes, source history, official read-only Git-free export replay and all 27 local onboarding tests passed on the submitted tree 09c4e6e8df8074724e5b3e030c0a4e13cc1021ea. Hosted verification is separate.
